intentionalClonePairs.reason: Parallel component-quality CLIs intentionally keep command-specific argument and diagnostic contracts explicit; sharing the small parser would couple distinct command UX without removing domain logic.
Production and validation CLIs deliberately keep their command-specific usage and error contracts explicit. The repeated --spec parsing is narrow CLI scaffolding rather than reusable product logic.
Web and native smoke scripts intentionally assert the same shared package exports as a parity contract while retaining runtime-specific component assertions.
